name: idle-wrap
description: Prompts the open session when it has sat idle near the prompt-cache cliff: resume unfinished work, or run /wrap --fast when nothing is in progress, instead of letting idle compaction summarize it

idleMinutes.title: Idle minutes before wrapping
idleMinutes.description: Minutes since the last turn before the mod submits the wrap prompt. Idle compaction fires at about 54; the default stays ahead of it.

minTokens.title: Minimum context tokens
minTokens.description: Sessions whose context is below this many tokens are left alone; a small session is cheap to re-read cold.

prompt.title: Prompt to submit
prompt.description: Submitted as the user's own words once the session is idle long enough. Plain text goes to the model (the default asks it to resume unfinished work, else wrap); a slash command runs as typed.
prompt.default: Idle check from the idle-wrap mod: this session has sat idle long enough that it is about to be wrapped. First decide whether you were still in the middle of something when the last turn ended: a background command or subagent you were waiting on, a CI run, deploy or other external process you said you would check back on, or a next step you announced and had not started. If so, pick up exactly where you left off and finish it; do not wrap, and do not ask whether to continue. Only if nothing is in progress and nothing is left to do should you run /wrap --fast now. If this session has already been wrapped and nothing has happened since, reply with one short line and stop.
